reviews.text: Friendly and knowledgeable staff, good variety of fish etc.

It's unfortunate that this is one of the only exotic pet stores in Amsterdam because they are keeping the animals and especially the rodents in such poor conditions. They should stick to selling only supplies for the exotic pets and not the pets themselves.
Large assortment of animals. In particular, animals and plants for an aquarium.

I am very disappointed with the quality of the fish at Exotica. I recently purchased a group of zebra danios here. Unfortunately, it turned out that the fish were given to me much too young. As they grew a little, serious genetic abnormalities came to light. Virtually all the fish have crooked backs and clear spinal deformities. This clearly points to severe inbreeding and a lack of responsible breeding. A professional pet store should not sell such deformed fish. It is very sad to see animal welfare being treated in this way. Quality control and expertise seem to be completely lacking here, unfortunately. I advise everyone against purchasing aquarium fish here.
Thanks to the expertise and customer-oriented attitude of the staff, you are assured of the right support in realizing a high-quality and optimally maintained aquarium.

Hello Sir, I bought a CANARY a few months ago and thought the first week that I was going to exchange it, but luckily I didn't. It was a young one and really sings like the BEST, incredible! Thank you very much again x

For years, I have been a very happy customer at Dierenhandel El Exotica. You are always greeted in a friendly manner, and the advice is expert and honest. They really take the time to think along with you and know their products and animals inside and out.

The quality of the food really speaks for itself. Just recently, I had a bag of birdseed on the carrier of my bicycle, and even before I got home, the local jackdaws were already busily feasting on it! That says enough about the attractiveness and quality of the food.

It is a shop you enjoy popping into, not only for the products, but also for the cozy atmosphere and personal attention. Highly recommended for anyone looking for the best for their animals.

I live in the neighbourhood and have passed by here a few times, bought cat food once when in a rush. One day I decided to lurk around the animal section and was absolutely horrified. You could absolutely tell that in another cage rodents were shivering balled up next to each other. Birds were given such small space, not even width to flap their wings on some angles. Just completely inhumane conditions. Anyone with couth let alone concern about animal care, treatment, and integrity, should avoid this place at all costs. Adjustments can be made… but they’re clearly not planning on it. Let’s not normalise cruelty for money.

Exotica has always been known in Amsterdam somewhat for the term animal trade rather than pet shop. However, now that I have a small aquarium, you don't always want to remain biased. Unfortunately, it has confirmed it after all…

Buying 10 fish and coming home with 9
Buying 5 snails where the employee says “just checking if they are actually inside the shell” and coming home to see that not a single snail has come out of a shell, in other words, I paid €10 for 5 snail shells … nah …. I’ll just go to Intratuin
I come there often with my daughter who has autism, they are super friendly and patient with her and never mind that we stay long and that she takes a lot of pictures. We always feel very welcomed
First service!

Reasonably nice shop. Helped quickly and enthusiastically. They did tell me 5 shrimp for 20, but when I got home there were only 4 in a bag. I should have looked more closely. The corydoras were nice and healthy though. I also had a beautiful guppy, but it died after just one day from a kind of growing lump. All the other fish, including the guppy in my tank, were and are otherwise just healthy. The water in my tank was tested afterwards and was fine. I realize that not everything can be perfect and that guppies mainly have the bad genetics, but I think it's a shame that I lost a shrimp and that the guppy died.
A very well-stocked shop. I bought everything I needed for my spiders and also bought two of the cutest rats in the world. The service was very friendly. I recommend
Great, sir

I visited this shop during my vacation and was honestly shocked.

The conditions for some of the animals, especially the rats and rabbits, seemed very poor. It looked like they barely got any fresh air and were kept in enclosures that were far too small.

This really saddened me. Animals are not commodities and deserve much better living conditions.

I sincerely hope things improve here.
Animals are kept in appalling conditions! It's a shame, no one alive deserves such a life (((
Rodents are not supposed to be in a such a small aqaurium without any air to breathe and food to eat. They half alife in a very bas state.

This is a very bad situation. First of all, if you ask a question, they act as if they don't understand Dutch; all the fish are sick. And if you ask at the counter about the fish on Marktplaats, they say,

"I don't know which fish you mean on Marktplaats, sir." So they don't understand your Dutch at the counter either, so this must be a shady business. My advice is: don't buy any fish here.

Nice shop near the Albert Kuip market. Many different animals for sale and on display.

It is always an adventure to discover which animals are in stock this time.
Highly recommended, followed by a pleasant stroll along the Albert Kuip.

Dierenhandel Exótica is a charming and well-established local pet shop that offers an impressive variety of supplies and specialized care for a wide range of animals. The store is packed with high-quality food, creative toys, and essential accessories, catering perfectly to both common household pets and more exotic species. What truly sets this place apart is the highly knowledgeable staff who are clearly passionate about animal welfare and always ready to provide expert advice on nutrition and habitat setups. It is a trusted neighborhood resource that provides a personalized and professional shopping experience for all pet owners.

I visited this pet shop today and I was shocked out of my wits. It is so sad how those animals live in enclosures that are far too small. The hamsters are kept multiple to a cage, even though hamsters are supposed to be alone. And let's not even talk about the reptiles. Poor housing conditions; there are far too small terrariums, and even a rat snake had been lying dead in its terrarium for a few days, judging by the state of its body. Please do not buy your pet here.
Good service and a great selection!
It's like stepping back in time; animal welfare is definitely not a priority here! Animals are kept very close together and are not kept in a humane way.
Friendly staff, lots of stuff for your animals and you get good advice.
A bit messy, but they take good care of their fish ieg.

Great staff!!!☺️
Wide selection.🤗 …

It's like going back to the 90s.
And that's very sad.
Small cages, the wrong bedding.
Rodents that are social animals are kept alone in a cage.
And the advice they give is completely pointless.
One mouse had a large wound on its back.
It made me very sad.
Friendly staff

Please shop at another store, not this one!!

Not only are the living conditions for all the animals here more than ridiculous, with cages that are unheated or insufficiently heated and, moreover, FAR too small, but advice is also given that is completely wrong.

The rodent cages were so incredibly small, and yet they were kept together in cages. The birds were kept in such large groups that there was absolutely no space and they couldn't even spread a wing. The snakes were kept together by the multiple in a single terrarium that is even too small for a single hatchling, and were described as animals that only move to eat and otherwise do not move. Well, is it any wonder they don't move when the only thing in the too-small terrarium is a single, too-small hiding place and a small water bowl?? This man has absolutely no knowledge or empathy for these kinds of animals, or even a single animal in his store. Going to a lot of trouble for a reptile and its living conditions is seen as strange and unnecessary, and incorrect advice is given regarding the heating and decoration of terrariums.
I eventually went to another dealer in Amsterdam Sloterdijk for my reptile, and I was immediately flooded with information, advice, and most importantly; interest. I felt much more welcome there (plus, they really had visible/audible experience in the trade), and therefore I will definitely not set foot in this shop again. This man has animals to sell them; there is no passion or interest in the trade to be seen.

Contrary to many reviews, I actually find the staff friendly, and as for the small cages… sorry, but when we were kids all the cages were arranged like that and that was just how it was back then. I think it is a nice, warm shop, just like you imagined a pet shop to be as a child.
Live stuff, cockroaches, etc. Something I was looking for
So awful, all those tiny animals in cages. Never buy from them if you love animals! They only do it for good. I hope they have to close due to poor animal welfare and this is still allowed!

Very unyielding staff. I asked for advice about fish and he walked away after every question, instead of thinking along with me. He also said that certain fish could be kept together, even though that is advised against everywhere. According to him, Google and things like that were nonsense. I also got the feeling that he wasn't really interested in selling me anything. I drove on to Pets Place, where I was helped very kindly and succeeded!
Awful and rude staff, the quality of life of most of the animals is horrifying. Please if you care about animals do not support them 💔 …

Isn't it time long past when pet shops were allowed to sell animals.... Too many critters locked up in bad conditions in cages that are too small .. I say in this day and age it should be banned.

I also read many reviews about sick critters that have been sold and I'm not surprised :-(
Amazing pet store ! With all types of animals. Ferrets, mice, birds, fish and reptiles. Highly recommend visiting. Have been shopping there for over 12 years
Animal suffering.
Animals are kept in very small cages in bad conditions; it is incredibly sad. It breaks my heart. Animals are not things!

Always very good customer service from Ron and his team. For such a small, compact shop, they truly have EVERYTHING (in the warehouse, of course). The animals are well cared for and good information is always provided.

I recently bought animals here.

Upon arriving home, it turned out to be the wrong gender.
I called and was able to exchange it immediately.
Good service!

We're thrilled with the hamster we recently got. It's a great shop with a wide selection and good products. The owner is a sweet guy, very Amsterdam-like. We're planning to get another hamster soon. Mr. Snuggles was already tame, and he's very gentle and sweet. My daughter is in love, and so are all her friends. Time for a friend! 🐹 Thanks.
I recently bought 1 male and 1 female beta Fish. The people help me alot with gitting the right fish and what im looking for. Friendly owners, I recommend the store
The seller is kind, friendly and helpful🥰 …

Animal cruelty! In this shop, where it's clearly all about the money and animal welfare isn't a priority for these people, the animals are crammed into cages that are far too small. They barely have any room to move around. And they seem depressed and bored.
What a disgusting way to treat animals!

We happened to be passing this shop and were looking for souvenirs for our pets. We were absolutely shocked by the condition of the animals; they were visibly sick and living in far too small glass cages. The guinea pig was trembling with fear, and the birds didn't even have room to fly. It's appalling that the animals are kept like this!

I bought two water turtles three weeks ago. It's because I immediately pointed out two turtles when he was in his tank; otherwise, I wouldn't have been allowed to choose. I didn't even get any CITES papers. It's a nice little shop, but the staff is very stiff and not exactly friendly.
So many poor animals locked up in small cages, one on top of the other. 5 rabbits in a cage that was 35x70cm at best. Horrible.
Friendly staff and they always give good advice about my bearded dragon. 🐲 …
Cool place

Bought 2 bettas at this shop today. Truly beautiful and a fantastic shop. The staff were friendly and willing to answer any question. We were even allowed to choose exactly which fish we wanted. This isn't the case everywhere. Received good advice and would definitely go there again!!🐟💓 …
That this pet shop is still allowed to exist… Those poor animals in small cages. Birds sitting alone and hopping from twig to twig because they can't even fly. This is extremely sad.
Poor handling of customers, gives no advice, and recommends going home to do your own undertook if you have questions.
friendly staff, cute pets

no good experiences. I bought mice for my daughter on December 30th because hers had died and she was very sad.

I hadn't even said yes yet when there were 3 mice in the cardboard box. I took them with me because the way he handled them, including grabbing them by the tail, which I didn't think was normal behavior.

What turned out to be the case upon arriving home a week later was a litter from the first mouse.

The other mouse turns out to be pregnant too.

She is due to give birth in a few days.

Even though I asked for 3 ladies.

I sent that man a message on Marktplaats and the only one I got as a reply was

this:
Good evening

That is indeed possible.
Our mice are kept together, males and females.

Is it a problem?

Kind regards
Ron

so I replied: yes actually it is, because thanks to you I will soon have 2 litters

then I got this: Sorry, we can make a mistake too, you can just come and exchange the man. No problem. And you can always bring the boys when they are about 4 or 5 weeks old.

Kind regards
Ron

I told him the mice aren't going away
they are in a loving family. and they are all staying

my advice never get animals from there please
I always get my live food here. I always receive good, friendly service. Very friendly staff and a great selection of live food.

We bought a hamster, our first pet, a new member of our family, and adopted him as a baby. He died today, five days after we bought him. He died of an illness that manifested itself almost immediately. I'm not the first to say that animals are kept in appalling conditions there. 10 in one small cage. Plus, they grab them roughly instead of holding them properly, causing them great stress. I'm absolutely horrified by this whole thing. We gave them a business card for questions about what to do if something was wrong with the pet, but they didn't answer when we called, and there was no communication. I don't recommend getting pets here. And let the animal welfare services pay attention after so many complaints. If no one is paying attention, then listen up, owner. I will definitely ensure all the necessary investigations are carried out, and you receive the full punishment for your treatment of animals that don't deserve such abuse. But any complaint against your store will definitely be on the welfare services' desk. Wait!

bought a hamster a month ago
definitely the best hamster one can ever have-- healthy, friendly to human, lovely, knows how to use toilet and so on
the shop owner is also very kind and really caring to the animals
They usually have special fish species that you cannot easily find in other aquarium shops. The fish are also of good quality.

I'm surprised with how much they can fit into a small space. And although cramped, the habitats were clean and the animals looked healthy. Though, like every pet store, the cages sold lacked in proper sizes. Always do research before purchasing an animal.

Very, very disappointed in this shop. I was looking for some new fish and saw a crayfish, never seen it in an aquarium before, so I asked the man if it was possible with other fish. Because it looked really nice.

I asked several times if it was possible, if he doesn't eat them, etc. A bit arrogantly, he told me they only eat plants. And in a delightfully condescending tone, "Yeah, otherwise it wouldn't be in here." Perfect, I'll take it.

This thing has now slaughtered several expensive and beautiful fish that I've had for years. Thanks for your so-called "expertise" and for really helping people with your "advice." Next time, be less arrogant and maybe learn a lesson from what you have in your shop. I'm not asking if it's possible for nothing.

Ten days ago, I bought a rat that turned out to be sick when I got home. Sneezing, rattling, constantly scratching. I hope my other rats don't get sick too. This rat squeaks and screeches when you try to pick it up normally; I understand why the seller grabs it by the tail. And I also understand why I wasn't allowed to see how the rat was kept.
A good breeder doesn't breed anxious, sick animals and at least gets them used to people when they're sold as pets.
These are simply rats bred for live food, and that's tolerated because they're for sale as "pets" when an inspector comes by. It's awful! It's up to you to use rodents as live food, but don't sell feeder rats as pets. You wouldn't sell a broiler chicken as a laying hen, would you?
This week, he's taking it to the vet again because he's getting sicker and sicker. Besides the disappointment, he's also incurred expenses thanks to a puppy farmer!
